 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Julius Randle's oldest son never really stopped being a New York kid. Even after the family moved to Minnesota, he and his old buddies stayed on FaceTime every day and played video games together. Friends flew out to see him. He made trips back. They found ways to keep being kids together, whatever the distance. Now he's back at his old school. The friendships maintained through screens and plane tickets are part of everyday life again. Randle's wife has her circle of friends nearby, and the veteran forward has his own community outside basketball. Monday brings another visit to Madison Square Garden, this time in a Nets uniform. But the family's homecoming is already well underway .
